_help: One entry per search. Tesla's inventory endpoint is queried once per entry.
model: my | m3 | ms | mx | ct      condition: new | used
zip + region: the search centre.  range_miles: Tesla accepts up to 200; 0 = nationwide.
trim_keywords: a car matches if its trim name contains ANY of these (case-insensitive).
exclude_keywords: ...and NONE of these.  Use it to drop Performance, Standard, etc.
trim_codes: optional exact Tesla option codes to filter server-side (e.g. ["LRRWD"]).
